bayesian_update.potential: remaining registered log-odds gap to posterior threshold

quadratic_gradient.drift: fixed log-error contraction per gradient step

common_form: expected/registered first hitting time = initial potential / per-step drift in these calibrated constant-drift cases
interpretation: Three materially different parent paradigms admit the same potential/progress first-hitting description once an appropriate paradigm-specific potential is supplied.
This does not establish a new GMI invariant because drift/hitting-time theory already owns the abstraction and because choosing a useful potential is itself the difficult structure-dependent step.
The live residual is structure/history -> useful pre-outcome potential+drift signature, not potential+drift -> hitting time.
